findings.evidence: Lines 73–75 provide no freeness/finiteness assumptions and lines 91–92 define the public abbreviation under that context; roadmap README lines 111–113 explicitly specifies `[Module.Free ℤ V] [Module.Finite ℤ V]` and explains that the integral lattice is primary.
findings.fix: Add `[Module.Free ℤ V] [Module.Finite ℤ V]` to the integral `HodgeStructure` abbreviation while retaining the assumption-free `HodgeStructureOn` and conjugation constructions.
findings.issue: `HodgeStructure` requires only `AddCommGroup V`, so torsion or infinitely generated groups are exposed as integral Hodge structures even though complexification can discard their integral information.

summary: The integral `HodgeStructure` interface is over-general: it admits infinite and torsion lattices, contrary to the roadmap’s finitely generated free integral datum.
